title: Old save initializes player HP and healing checkpoint

verification.actor: Player field runtime loaded from the unchanged old HeartGold save.
verification.trigger: Load the saved game normally, then read the HP record at one completed field boundary.
verification.observable: The ROM and live overlay identities match, current and saved HP are 100, and the healing checkpoint is a valid spawn ID.

setupMutations.change: Copy the unchanged test.nds and test.sav into a private shared session. No player HP, actor, party, or map writes.

limits: This proves old-save initialization at one completed field boundary. It does not prove damage, rest timing, movement reset, or blackout.
A missing descriptor, wrong ROM overlay, stale field/save owner, or invalid save record fails the read.

events.value: Read the checked player HP state.

stop.condition: One checked player HP receipt or first failure.
